subject: regional-marathi
title: Marathi — Set 2
description: Common phrases, colours, and nature words

questions.question: What does 'आभारी आहे' (Abhaari ahe) mean?
questions.explanation: 'आभारी आहे' means 'I am grateful' or Thank you in Marathi. It expresses deep thanks.

questions.question: What does 'दूध' (Dudh) mean?
questions.explanation: 'दूध' means milk in Marathi. This word is the same in Hindi as well.

questions.question: What does 'झाड' (Zhaad) mean?
questions.explanation: 'झाड' means tree in Marathi. 'झाडे' is the plural (trees).

questions.question: What does 'पाऊस' (Paus) mean?
questions.explanation: 'पाऊस' means rain in Marathi. Maharashtra has a strong monsoon season.

questions.question: How do you say 'two' in Marathi?
What does 'रात्र' (Raatra) mean?
questions.explanation: 'रात्र' means night in Marathi. 'सकाळ' is morning and 'संध्याकाळ' is evening.

questions.question: What does 'मित्र' (Mitra) mean?
questions.explanation: 'मित्र' means friend in Marathi. It comes from Sanskrit 'मित्रम्'.

questions.question: What does 'काय' (Kaay) mean?
questions.explanation: 'काय' means What in Marathi. Example: 'तुझं नाव काय?' = What is your name?

questions.question: What does 'दिवस' (Divas) mean?
questions.explanation: 'दिवस' means day in Marathi. 'आज दिवस चांगला आहे' = Today is a good day.

questions.question: In which Indian state is Marathi the official language?
questions.explanation: Marathi is the official language of Maharashtra. It is also spoken in parts of Goa, Karnataka, and Madhya Pradesh.
